events.what: Li, Moriah and Pinsky post 'Tunnel number one knots satisfy the Berge Conjecture' (arXiv:1701.01421 v1); v3 withdrawn Sept 2018, repaired v4 Dec 2019; v6 Apr 2023, v7 1 Nov 2024; published Geometry & Topology 29(6), 2025

judgement.doubts: The repaired argument dates at latest to v4 (Dec 2019); the record shows no new mathematics in v7 (Nov 2024) and its own what_would_settle_it admits the v6->v7 diff is unknown. If v7 fixed a substantive refereeing gap, the event would move to 1 Nov 2024 and the status would be partial. The case is tunnel number one knots only; the general conjecture stays open per the record.

outcome_prefix: Judged: the only event is Li–Moriah–Pinsky's tunnel-number-one case, first posted January 2017 and repaired December 2019, so it predates the snapshot; its 2025 journal publication is vetting, not a new event, and the bullet stays open.

corrections.why: F7: the record says v1 'making exactly this claim with a purported proof, was posted 5 January 2017' and the repair came as v4 in December 2019; nothing in the record shows new mathematics in v7 or the 2025 journal version, so the journal date is not the event date.

F7/§4 step 5: the only surviving event is a pre-snapshot case (tunnel number one knots). A pre-snapshot partial result is a note on a problem still open, not partial and not open_stale; the record says 'The general Berge conjecture ... remains open'.
